title: Path-Space Robust Bayesian Portfolio Selection
abstract: arXiv:2606.24212v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A Bayesian investor learns an unknown asset drift by Kalman--Bucy filtering and trades using the resulting estimate, but the observation model used for learning may itself be misspecified. We make the portfolio robust to an adversary who distorts the law of observed prices and pays a relative-entropy penalty. A single distortion affects both trading returns and learning, since wealth and the drift estimate respond to the same observed prices. The observation market is complete, so the fixed-target problem becomes an optimization over terminal tracking errors. Entropy duality removes the adversary's inner optimization, and the pricing budget reduces the investor's problem to one scalar equation for the budget multiplier. We show that the resulting payoff is replicable, and together with its worst-case measure forms an attained saddle. The robust position has the same sign as the non-robust one but a smaller size, and it tends to zero

translated_title: 路径空间鲁棒贝叶斯投资组合选择
translated_abstract: 一位贝叶斯投资者通过卡尔曼-布西滤波学习未知的资产漂移率，并利用所得估计进行交易，但用于学习的观测模型本身可能存在误设。我们使投资组合对一个扭曲观测价格规律的对手方具有鲁棒性，该对手方需支付相对熵惩罚。由于财富和漂移估计都响应于相同的观测价格，单一扭曲会同时影响交易收益与学习过程。观测市场是完全市场，因此固定目标问题转化为对终端跟踪误差的优化。熵对偶性消除了对手方的内层优化问题，而定价预算将投资者的问题简化为关于预算乘子的一个标量方程。我们证明所得到的收益是可复制的，并且与最坏情况测度一起构成一个可达的鞍点。鲁棒头寸与非鲁棒头寸符号相同但规模更小，且趋于零。
tldr: 本文提出路径空间鲁棒的贝叶斯投资组合选择方法，通过相对熵惩罚应对观测模型误设，证明鲁棒最优收益可复制并与最坏情况测度构成可达鞍点，且鲁棒头寸与非鲁棒头寸同号但规模更小并趋于零。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a path-space robust Bayesian portfolio selection framework guarding against misspecified observation models via a relative-entropy penalty, proves the robust optimal payoff is replicable and forms an attained saddle with the worst-case measure, and shows the robust position has the same sign as the non-robust one but a smaller size that tends to zero.
